Sam: Morning — quick sync on the Nov 9 partner workshop with NimbusCloud + VoltEdge. Need speaker confirm, demo fallback, swag bundle list, and press-drop timing.
Priya: I have speaker confirmations from Nimbus (Asha, Tom). Waiting on VoltEdge engineer (Rina). ETA EOD today.
Liam: For demos: primary = live inference on Redwood Dedicated, fallback = recorded run + static demo VM. Ops needs the recorded clip by Nov 7.
Jules: Noted. Can we get a short embargoed press blurb from Nimbus by Nov 6? Marketing wants 48h lead.
Marco: Swag question — do we want partner co-branded stickers + one tech sample (mini dev kit) per speaker? Logistics to ship to hotel?
Sam: Yes to co-branded stickers. Keep dev kit count small (10). Shipping to hotel on Nov 8 morning. Priya, can you confirm courier and wine-check policy? @Priya
Priya: Courier = ShipQuick (account 7782). They can hold at front desk if we provide guest names. I'll add instructions.
Liam: Demo fallback checklist (short):
```
- Recorded clip (mp4) by Nov 7
- Static VM image + README (s3 link) by Nov 8
- On-site tester assigned (Jules)
```
Jules: I'll be on-site tester. Will do one end-to-end test morning of Nov 9 at 8:30am PT.
Marco: Swag manifest (short):
- 50 co-branded stickers
- 10 mini dev kits
- 5 speaker swag boxes (hoodie + notebook)
- 1 press kit box (for onsite handoff)
I can upload full CSV to the tracker.
OpsBot: Reminder: Conference wifi reported flaky at venue. Suggest mobile hotspot plan and local fallback region routing enabled for demos.
Sam: Good catch. Enable region fallback to us-west-2 and reserve 1 Dedicated slot for canary. Priya, please confirm the Dedicated reservation by EOD.
Priya: Confirmed — reserved 1 x p4d-equivalent slot Nov 9 07:00–13:00 PT. Added fallback routing rule with ops.
Liam: One more — run-of-show cue: speaker transitions + demo handoff at :40 past each 20-min block. I'll draft and share.
Sam: Perfect. Tasks summary: Priya = courier + GPU reservation + partner blurb chase; Jules = on-site test; Marco = full swag CSV + ship; Liam = run-of-show + demo assets; Sam = speaker comms + press handoff.
Jules: All good from my side. If wifi dies, we'll play recorded clip and run interactive Q&A.
Sam: Thanks team. If anyone gets speaker confirmations or press blurbs, drop them here. :thumbsup:
Priya: Adding tracker link: https://tracker.redwood/integrations/nimbus-nov9 — upload assets there.
Marco: Uploading swag CSV now.
Liam: Draft run-of-show uploaded to the tracker and pinged marketing.
Sam: Closing loop — final preflight call Nov 8 16:00 PT. Invite sent.
OpsBot: Meeting created: Nov 8 16:00 PT — preflight (channel: partnerships).
